description: Fetch Glassdoor employee & employer reviews by numeric company_id (e.g. "1001330" for Printful) OR by company name query (auto-resolves company_id first), including Pros, Cons, Advice to Management, job title, current/former employee status, workplace sub-ratings, 1–5 star distribution histogram, and aspect sentiment polarities. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned (0 Credits if empty).

company_id.description: Numeric Glassdoor company_id (e.g. "1001330" for Printful) or Glassdoor company URL. Optional if query is provided.

query.description: Company name (e.g. "Printful") — if company_id is omitted, automatically searches Glassdoor to resolve company_id first.

name: glassdoor_reviews
title: Extract Glassdoor Employee Pros, Cons, Sub-Ratings & Sentiment Polarity
